description: This file defines plotting classes and methods for pandas-on-Spark, including base classes for top-N, sampled, numeric, histogram, box, and KDE plots, as well as a pandas-on-Spark plotting accessor that manages different backends and provides plotting functions like line, bar, box, histogram, KDE, area, pie, scatter, and hexbin.

classes.name: TopNPlotBase
classes.description: Base class for top-N plotting, providing methods to get top N data and set result text on axes.

classes.name: SampledPlotBase
classes.description: Base class for sampled data plotting, providing methods to get sampled data and set result text on axes.

classes.name: NumericPlotBase
classes.description: Base class for numeric data plotting, including data preparation for numeric plots.

classes.name: HistogramPlotBase
classes.description: Class for histogram plotting, including methods to prepare histogram data, get bins, and compute histograms.

classes.name: BoxPlotBase
classes.description: Class for box plot computation, including calculation of quartiles, outliers, and whiskers.

classes.name: KdePlotBase
classes.description: Class for KDE plot computation, including data preparation and KDE calculation.

classes.name: PandasOnSparkPlotAccessor
classes.description: Plotting accessor for pandas-on-Spark Series/DataFrames, managing backends and providing plotting methods like line, bar, box, hist, kde, area, pie, scatter, and hexbin.

methods.name: get_top_n
methods.description: Retrieve top N elements from data, converting to pandas DataFrame.

methods.name: set_result_text
methods.description: Set annotation text on axes indicating partial or sampled data.

methods.name: get_sampled
methods.description: Retrieve a sampled subset of data, either by ratio or random sampling.

methods.name: prepare_numeric_data
methods.description: Convert data to numeric columns suitable for plotting.

methods.name: prepare_hist_data
methods.description: Prepare histogram data and bins.

methods.name: get_bins
methods.description: Calculate histogram bin boundaries based on data.

methods.name: compute_hist
methods.description: Compute histogram counts for Spark DataFrame columns.

methods.name: compute_box
methods.description: Calculate box plot statistics including quartiles, outliers, and whiskers.

methods.name: prepare_kde_data
methods.description: Prepare data for KDE plotting.

methods.name: get_ind
methods.description: Generate evaluation points for KDE.

methods.name: compute_kde_col
methods.description: Compute KDE values for input column at specified points.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initialize the pandas-on-Spark plot accessor with data.

methods.name: _find_backend
methods.description: Find and load a plotting backend module.

methods.name: _get_plot_backend
methods.description: Retrieve the plotting backend module based on option or argument.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Dispatch plotting call to the backend with specified kind.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Plot data as a line plot.

methods.name: bar
methods.description: Plot data as a vertical bar plot.

methods.name: barh
methods.description: Plot data as a horizontal bar plot.

methods.name: box
methods.description: Plot data as a box plot.

methods.name: hist
methods.description: Plot data as a histogram.

methods.name: kde
methods.description: Plot data as a KDE (Kernel Density Estimate).

methods.name: density
methods.description: Alias for kde.

methods.name: area
methods.description: Plot data as a stacked area plot.

methods.name: pie
methods.description: Plot data as a pie chart.

methods.name: scatter
methods.description: Create a scatter plot.

methods.name: hexbin
methods.description: Create a hexbin plot (unsupported function).
